caption: The drawing depicts a detailed close-up of a plant, primarily featuring the curled frond of a fern that is unfurling. The frond is composed of small, scale-like shapes in shades of light pink, beige, and brown, with green highlights indicating the main stem and the leafy edges. The left side of the drawing includes a vertical section of dark green foliage or background, contrasting with the central and right sections, which are dominated by a beige, mosaic-like background pattern. The composition focuses on the spiral form of the fern frond, which occupies most of the left and lower parts of the image, with the background filling the top and right side. The art style uses small, rounded brushstrokes to create a textured, mosaic effect throughout the drawing. At the bottom of the drawing, there are inscriptions, including a sequence of letters and numbers on the left and the name "Ruth N. Barnes" on the right.
title: Hooked Rug
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
